releaseNotes: v1.3.5: LAUNCHED THE LOCAL ACCOUNTING BRAIN for Batman ('العقل المحاسبي المحلي'); also VAT REMOVED everywhere ('شيل الضريبة') — orders/receipts no longer add any tax (hard 0 in checkout, offline addOrder/updateOrder/createWithPayment; 'ضريبة القيمة المضافة' row hides automatically; settings UI shows disabled 0%); and ALL invoice/thermal/preview views now force tax=0 even for previously-saved orders (orderTotalsForDisplay single source). NEW SHIFT POLICY (قرار الإدارة): cash no longer requires an open cash shift/drawer — the 'افتح الشيف أولاً'/cash block is removed from cash payment (selectPaymentAndClose) and cash expense (saveExpenseFromText / batman shift_required branch); the 💰 drawer is now optional (reconciliation/close only, never blocks); knowledge docs re-versioned to 1.0.1 to match the new policy (cash expenses saved directly, drawer-linked automatically if open). Knowledge Base: new knowledge/ folder with 8 Arabic (Egyptian dial.) accounting documents (terms, food cost, gross profit/break-even, prime cost, expense classification & cash policy, inventory valuation, purchase cycle, daily reporting/EOE), loaded through a unified idempotent importer (knowledge/importer.js) that seeds window.LuccaDB.KnowledgeBase in BOTH modes (offline IndexedDB + online Supabase) with version-based duplicate protection (ver: TAG) — and, when the remote knowledge tables are missing (Supabase PGRST205 pre-migration), it automatically falls back to a self-contained local IndexedDB mirror (lucca_knowledge_local) so the knowledge/RAG layer never goes silent (mode reported via LuccaKnowledge.mode()). RAG: batman-dashboard sendChat now retrieves knowledge chunks before answering, grounds Ollama prompts with sources, and can answer purely from the local KB when Ollama is off (no invented numbers); truth-trust tags: 🧮/📊 compute/live-DB, 📚 knowledge, 🧠 AI interpretation. 13 accounting tools added to the AI engine (getSalesReport, getExpenses, getPurchases, getInventory, getProductCost, calculateFoodCost, calculateGrossProfit, calculateGrossMargin, calculatePrimeCost, getCashRegisterStatus, getDailySummary, getProductProfitability, exportAccountingReport) — all computed in JS from the real DB (never by the LLM), routed via accountingCommand dispatcher from both Batman and the POS chat. Tests: 12/12 knowledge unit (incl. local fallback) + 17/17 accounting tools (29 suite). Rebuild: LuccaPOS-Setup-1.3.5.exe. Previous: v1.3.4 fixed the 'افتح الشيف أولاً' cash-shift block; v1.3.3 real expense recording through Batman.
